mode_script.missing_gate: Does not require valid_slots==3 or verify all current/requested/saved mode fields before mutation. Add valid_slots==3 and assert get_usb_mode consistency before set/save.
mode_script.recovery: IO4 target leaves the board in IO4 after reboot; a separate physical GP9 forced-normal recovery plus explicit NORMAL save/reboot is required.

hid_probe.filters: VID_0CA3/PID_0021; reads device serial; access=0; validates UsagePage=1/Usage=4/input report length64 before actual input read
hid_probe.issue: With --get-input-report it calls HidD_GetInputReport for each matching serial interface, then asserts target count is exactly one only after enumeration. Multiple same-serial interfaces can therefore receive multiple control reads before uniqueness fails.
hid_probe.required_fix: Perform complete metadata enumeration and require exactly one matching serial + expected usage/caps before any HidD_GetInputReport. Keep the unique candidate handle open, then issue exactly one read; if count is not one, save diagnostics and make zero query calls.

incident.hold: Do not reconnect power or issue CDC/HID requests until fully de-energized, cooled, visually inspected, and parent/user decides safe next step. GP9 test predates incident and is not a post-incident health check.
incident.status: Board reported hot after accidental 5V-to-GND contact; no IO4 switch was executed

limitations: No scripts executed and no hardware requested by reviewer.
Even after incident clearance, this one-shot test would not prove repeated IO4 reliability or game compatibility.
4MiB firmware metadata does not independently verify physical Flash capacity.
